Lemma
[Infinite propagation speed]

↗ def:heat-convolution-solution \group Heat Equation

If $g\in C(\R ^n)$ has compact support, $g\ge 0$, and $g$ is positive somewhere, then its heat convolution satisfies $u(x,t)>0$ for all $x\in \R ^n$ and $t>0$.
Proof

\sketch The Gaussian is everywhere positive for $t>0$, while continuity makes $g$ positive on a nonempty open set. The nonnegative integrand is therefore positive on a set of positive measure.

□
